name: cta-optimization
title: CTA Optimization
description: Review and improve calls-to-action: clarity, placement, hierarchy and friction.
when_to_use: Any page with a conversion goal.
instructions: Primary CTA verb + outcome ("Book a furnace inspection"), visible above the fold on mobile, repeated after proof.
One primary CTA style per view; secondary paths (phone) visually subordinate but always reachable.
